system.description:
Your history is eclipsed by a major negative event that shaped the rest of your life. You struggle to overcome the memory of the tragic event, be it the loss of a loved one or something that happened to you directly. Either way, the tragedy both fuels and haunts you.

Qualities

Assign a d10 and a d8 to two of these qualities:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.jLRoVcoc8Dz0Kiio]{Banter}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.JbpF0zq2JHhwxVHD]{Close Combat}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.TepWLbqMhXMPjkRO]{Imposing}

• Select from Mental qualities category

Principle

Choose an Ideals principle.

Power Source

Roll d10, d10, d6 for power source selection.
